newsitem.title: USA: Penney sees possible $200 mln chg in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Penney sees possible $200 mln chg in 1997.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc said Monday that it is offering voluntary early retirement to about 1,500 of its management associates, which could result in a $200 million pretax charge later this year if all those eligible accept the offer.
The company also said that if all eligible associates participate in the program, it will be able to reduce its annual costs by about $120 million.

James Oesterreicher, chief executive officer, said in a statement that "We are firmly committed to accelerating our ongoing expense reduction program and significantly lowering our expense-to-sales ratio. We will increase our operating efficiencies, work on process changes, and implement additional cost-saving initiatives.

"We realize that these programs must carefully balance our need to deliver value to our shareholders with our responsibility to treat our associates fairly and to provide enhanced service to our customers. This voluntary program is an example of how that balance can be achieved. The Voluntary Retirement Program enables us to draw on our deep 'bench strength' and will provide new career development opportunities for many of our associates."
